title: Add a compliance certificate, or Enroll in Schedule, from the panel
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with View work orders, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A work order carries an asset that is enrolled on a schedule (or carries a compliance record), with at least one service due soon, due today or overdue, e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12', service 'PM-A'.
  3. Open that work order and find the maintenance panel inside the asset card.
custom_steps:
1. From the panel, add a compliance certificate and confirm it works as from the asset.
  2. On a work order whose asset is on no schedule, confirm the panel offers Enroll in Schedule, opening the same modal as enrolment (S7).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A compliance certificate is addable from the panel as well as from the asset.
  • Where the asset is on no schedule, the panel offers Enroll in Schedule, opening the same modal as S7.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10572 (S16, The maintenance panel on a work order); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S16; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S16-R10: “A compliance certificate will be addable from the panel as well as from the asset”
  • S16-R11: “Where the asset is on no schedule, the panel offers Enroll in Schedule, opening the same modal as S7”
